title: CutRight per-project cloud-analysis config
description: Persisted at <project>/analysis/cloud-analysis/cloud-config.json. A project with no such file behaves exactly as if it had one with consent=false, budget_usd_limit=0, upload_policy=proxy — cloud analysis is off by default (REV2 plan §15.6).

credential_env_var.description: Name of an environment variable an eventual real provider adapter reads a credential from at call time. Never a credential value.
